paper_title: Operation of a ferromagnetic axion haloscope at $m_a=58\,μ$eV
notes: First QUAX ferromagnetic haloscope prototype result: upper limit g_aee < 4.9e-10 at 95% C.L. for m_a = 58 ueV (14 GHz), assuming local DM density 0.45 GeV/cm^3. The exclusion (Fig. 8) spans a narrow ~3 MHz frequency band around 14 GHz from seven runs; only the best (minimum) coupling value is given numerically in text, so a single data point is reported. Axion wind (gradient) coupling to electron spins; sensitivity depends on daily-modulated wind direction (data taken at maximum of daily modulation). | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.85, 1))
